## Options differ

Ways to address it:

- Change Figma to match code (rename or add the option in place; never delete and recreate a variant).
- Allow-list it when the code option is an alias (for example `size=default` is `size=md`).

| Component        | Property | Code                                    | Figma                     | Note                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Dialog           | size     | sm / md / lg / xl / full                | md / sm / lg              | allowed: xl and full are not drawn. Every size is a max-width cap in code (w-full max-w-*), so a wider dialog resizes the instance, and full is 95vw by 95vh with no fixed width. Figma keeps sm, md and lg like Sheet, Popover and Hover Card (owner decision 2026-11-10). |
| Page Layout      | variant  | default / centered / full-width         | default / centered        | allowed: full-width matches default at the 960px frame (the container never reaches its max width). Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).                                                                            |
| Section Features | variant  | default / grid / cards                  | default / cards           | allowed: grid has the same background and layout as default. Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).                                                                                                                   |
| Skeleton         | size     | sm / md / lg / xl                       | sm / md / lg              | allowed: xl resolves to the same 40px as lg. Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).                                                                                                                                   |
| Skeleton         | variant  | default / text / circular / rectangular | default / text / circular | allowed: rectangular has the same radius as default. Figma draws only the looks that differ at rest (builder rule, kept by the owner 2026-11-04).                                                                                                                           |
